note: New Zealand's four largest banks are ANZ, ASB, BNZ and Westpac. ASB's and Westpac's card rates-and-fees pages answer 403, and ANZ's pages carry Incapsula and now load their rates by script, which this research doesn't render (2026-10-30); so ANZ's Low Rate Visa is kept as read on 2026-10-29 and BNZ's two cards on sale are added. ANZ New Zealand's page for its Low Rate Visa (read 2026-10-29): no annual card fee, and 13.90% a year on purchases (kept as read). BNZ's pages (read 2026-10-30): the Lite Visa, 13.50% a year on purchases and 22.95% on cash advances, a 5-dollar half-yearly account fee, up to 55 days interest-free, and a minimum monthly repayment of 2% of the balance or 25 dollars, whichever is more; the Advantage Visa Platinum, 18.95% a year on purchases and cash advances, a 45-dollar half-yearly account fee, up to 44 interest-free days (its minimum repayment isn't stated on its page and isn't written); for both, a cash advance in New Zealand 0.90 dollars (none on overseas withdrawals), a late payment fee of 2 dollars, and a foreign currency service fee of 2.25% of the NZ dollar value. BNZ's cards no longer on sale (Advantage Visa Classic, the Private Bank Advantage Visa Platinum) and its business cards aren't written.
